description:
Make it mine, for a long-form opening or a package: write up to n (1 to 5, default
    3) new ones for your niche that keep one real find's structure. From a long find,
    `written` holds openings: hook (what the creator says first), then (what the next half
    minute has to deliver) and kept_structure, built on the find's template and its order
    of beats. From a packaging find it holds packages: title, thumbnail (what to show and
    how to frame it), thumbnail_text (the words to print, or null) and kept_structure,
    built on its title template and its thumbnail's composition.

    Returns {"find_id", "kind", "niche", "n", "written", "label", "credits_charged": 1,
    "credits"}. label says they were written by Hook Detector from a real opening's (or
    package's) structure: show it with them, never present one as a real video's. One that
    is the real find's own words is dropped. They are never added to a run, a keep or an
    export. Costs 1 credit per call, taken before the model is asked and refunded when it
    does not answer (503 model_unavailable). 402 insufficient_credits at a balance of 0;
    404 find_not_found; limited per account per hour (429 rate_limited). Needs the
    research permission. The answer carries remix_id: list_remixes and get_remix read it
    back, free. Same as POST /v1/finds/{find_id}/remix.

find_id.description: one of your finds (from get_run, get_find, list_finds or list_kept_finds)
find_id.title: Find Id

idempotency_key.description: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters; the same key and request within 24 hours answer the saved remix and charge nothing; the same key with another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

niche.description: your niche, product or audience, as you would say it (1 to 120 characters)
niche.title: Niche

name: remix_find
